The Apple MacBook Neo includes 8GB unified memory that enables efficient communication between the CPU, GPU, and Neural Engine. Apple A18 Pro chip

The Apple MacBook Neo delivers impressive everyday performance with the powerful Apple A18 Pro chip. This advanced Apple processor features a 6-core CPU with two performance cores and four efficiency cores. Apple MacBook Neo also integrates a 5-core GPU with hardware-accelerated ray tracing for enhanced graphics performance in games, design tasks, and visual workloads. Apple MacBook Neo includes a 16-core Neural Engine designed for advanced AI workloads and intelligent features. The chip delivers up to 60GB/s memory bandwidth, ensuring faster data access and smoother application performance. This Apple Laptop also features a dedicated Media Engine supporting hardware-accelerated H.264, HEVC, ProRes, and ProRes RAW processing. Video decode, video encode, and ProRes encode engines allow faster editing and playback. Apple Neo additionally supports AV1 decoding for modern streaming formats and optimized video efficiency.

13-inch Liquid Retina Display

The MacBook Neo features a vibrant 13-inch Liquid Retina display that delivers exceptional clarity and color accuracy. The LED-backlit IPS panel offers a native resolution of 2408 by 1506 pixels at 219 pixels per inch. Apple MacBook Neo also supports one billion colors and the sRGB color space for realistic visuals. MacBook provides a visually immersive experience when watching movies, editing photos, or browsing content. Combined with powerful graphics from the A18 Pro chip, Apple Neo ensures smooth visuals across apps, games, and multimedia playback.

Up to 16 Hours of Battery Performance

The MacBook Neo provides excellent battery performance designed for mobile productivity. Users can enjoy up to 16 hours of video streaming on a single charge. Apple Laptop includes a 20W USB-C power adapter and a 1.5-meter USB-C charging cable. This efficient charging solution keeps Apple Neo ready for work, study, or travel.

1080p FaceTime HD Camera

The MacBook Neo enhances video calls and media playback with high-quality audio and imaging components. The Apple Laptop includes a 1080p FaceTime HD camera with advanced image signal processing. Computational video technology improves image clarity during meetings, online classes, and video chats. Apple MacBook Neo also supports 1080p HD video recording for clear visual communication.

Dual-Speaker Sound System

The MacBook Neo Laptop features a dual-speaker sound system supporting Spatial Audio with Dolby Atmos. This audio technology creates immersive sound when listening to music or watching movies. Apple Neo also includes a dual-microphone array with directional beamforming for clearer voice capture. Voice Isolation and Wide Spectrum microphone modes improve communication quality during calls. A Magic Keyboard with Touch ID and a responsive Multi-Touch trackpad provide comfortable typing and precise navigation.

Connectivity: Wi-Fi 6E, Bluetooth 6, & Two USB Type-C

The MacBook Neo offers reliable connectivity through modern wireless technologies and versatile ports. This MacBook supports Wi-Fi 6E for faster and more stable internet connections. Bluetooth 6 ensures seamless pairing with wireless accessories. Apple MacBook Neo also includes two USB-C ports, including one USB 3 port supporting DisplayPort and speeds up to 10Gb/s. The second port supports USB 2 connectivity and charging. A 3.5mm headphone jack allows convenient wired audio connections. Apple Neo supports one external display with up to 4K resolution at 60Hz while simultaneously running the built-in display.

macOS Ecosystem

The MacBook Neo runs macOS, offering smooth performance, free updates, built-in security, and strong privacy protection. The lightweight Apple Laptop measures only 0.50 inches thick and weighs 1.23 kilograms. MacBook Neo comes in elegant Silver, Blush, Citrus, and Indigo finishes with a durable recycled aluminum enclosure.
